svg.text: one name, postgres: a Patroni cluster

g.title: Clients → API Gateway · REST with the user's JWT
API Gateway → Message Broker · the queue of the service that owns the path (/v1/queues/{service}/…)
Message Broker ↔ Guild · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Notification · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Map · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ User Management · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Package Registry · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Monster Raid · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Tamagotchi · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Message Broker ↔ Battle · user requests (HTTP, least-loaded replica), calls (gRPC Handle) and events (gRPC Deliver) all pass here
Clients → guild-ws · Guild's chat WebSocket, the one direct connection
guild-ws → Guild · forwards the chat WebSocket
API Gateway → Service Discovery · registers itself
Message Broker → Service Discovery · reads replicas and topics, evicts a replica whose breaker opened

g.data-nodes: sd guild notification map user-management package-registry monster-raid tamagotchi battle
g.title: Every replica → Service Discovery · registers (address, gRPC port, topics), heartbeat every 5 s

g.data-nodes: sd guild notification map user-management package-registry monster-raid tamagotchi battle
g.title: Service Discovery → every replica · polls /status (health and load)
Service Discovery → Telegram and Discord · a replica is down / answers again
Message Broker → broker-data · events and deliveries are stored before the publisher gets its answer

g.data-nodes: postgres guild notification map user-management package-registry monster-raid tamagotchi battle
g.title: Every service → postgres (the router) · its own database, on the current leader
Prometheus → API Gateway · scrapes /metrics
Prometheus → Message Broker · scrapes /metrics
Prometheus → Service Discovery · scrapes /metrics (every replica's health and load)
Grafana → Prometheus · queries metrics
Grafana → Loki · queries logs
Grafana Alloy → Loki · pushes every container's logs

g.data-nodes: alloy guild notification map user-management package-registry monster-raid tamagotchi battle gateway broker sd
g.title: Every container → Grafana Alloy · Alloy reads the logs of all 25 containers through the Docker socket
API Gateway → Loki · the admin log download (GET /api/v1/admin/logs)
Notification → Firebase Cloud Messaging · push to the user's devices
Map → User Management · gRPC Broker.Call · filter friends, enemies and nearby candidates
User Management → Package Registry · gRPC Broker.Call · verify wallet registrations and raid reward rules
Package Registry → User Management · gRPC Broker.Call · validate the developer's identity
Package Registry → Guild · gRPC Broker.Call · check a scheduled raid's target guild
Notification → Guild · gRPC Broker.Call · find who gets a raid notification
Guild → User Management · gRPC Broker.Call · verify the invitee and the friendship
Guild → Package Registry · gRPC Broker.Call · check the shared package
Tamagotchi → Package Registry · gRPC Broker.Call · verify registration, care rules and sprites
Battle → Tamagotchi · gRPC Broker.Call · reserve pets, settle XP and transfers
Battle → Package Registry · gRPC Broker.Call · snapshot stats and rules
Battle → User Management · gRPC Broker.Call · settle the global currency
Monster Raid → Guild · gRPC Broker.Call · check membership
Monster Raid → Tamagotchi · gRPC Broker.Call · reserve primary pets
Monster Raid → Package Registry · gRPC Broker.Call · read the raid rules
Monster Raid → User Management · gRPC Broker.Call · settle rewards
Guild → Notification · topic guild.invited
Map → Notification · topic users.nearby
User Management → Notification · topic friend.requested
User Management → Map · topic friend.removed, enemy.unmarked
Monster Raid → Notification · topic raid.started, raid.finished
Package Registry → Monster Raid · topic raid.activation-requested, raid.cancellation-requested
Battle → Tamagotchi · topic battle.finished
API Gateway → cache · cached GET answers (X-Cache) and verified tokens, on the node the hash ring picks
Message Broker → cache · user lookups between services; gen:<service> makes cached answers stale; auth:revoked:<user> locks out an account being deleted
postgres router → pg-1, pg-2, pg-3 · 5432 to the leader, 5433 to a replica, from each node's Patroni REST API (/primary, /replica), checked every second
pg-1, pg-2, pg-3 → etcd · the leader renews its lock every 2 s; when it expires (20 s), the synchronous replica takes it
ETL service → postgres:5433 · every team database, from a replica, as the read-only etl_reader (the leader only when no replica answers)
ETL service → warehouse · loads the star schema in one transaction, every 60 s
Grafana → warehouse · the Lab 5 dashboard's SQL panels, as the read-only dw_reader
Prometheus → pg-1, pg-2, pg-3 · Patroni's /metrics (role, timeline, replication lag); it also scrapes the ETL service
Cache: cache-1, cache-2, cache-3
postgres: the database router (HAProxy)
Database cluster: pg-1, pg-2, pg-3 (Patroni)
etcd
ETL service
Data warehouse
Clients
guild-ws
Telegram · Discord
Service Discovery
